pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-angular to rounded polygons with diffuse, soft-pixel edge gradients. Patch area is larger on the shoulder and upper flank, decreasing in relative spatial area toward the posterior pelvic region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream topological graph with high continuity. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is moderate on the flank, narrowing significantly toward the distal hindquarter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper cervical ridge. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D profile against the background.
